editorNote: A crypto-heavy day: Binance reopens withdrawals after its hack, gold sits under $4,000, and Duolingo and Rocket Lab headlines round out the watchlist. Every item rests on a headline only; bodies could not be retrieved.

stories.headline: Binance resumes bitcoin and ether withdrawals after covering the bulk of a stolen $6.3 billion, Reuters reports
stories.summary: A Reuters headline says Binance has resumed bitcoin and ether withdrawals after covering most of the roughly $6.3 billion stolen, while CoinDesk's headline says withdrawals reopen in phases, starting with bitcoin. The article body could not be retrieved.
stories.whyItMatters: If the headlines are accurate, customers regain access to withdrawals following the hack.

sourceLinks.title: Binance resumes bitcoin, ether withdrawals after covering bulk of stolen $6.3 billion - Reuters
Binance opens crypto withdrawals in phases starting with bitcoin following $6.3 billion hack - CoinDesk

stories.headline: Duolingo heads for its worst day in months after the CEO flags slower growth, Stocktwits says
stories.summary: A Stocktwits headline says Duolingo stock was heading for its worst day in months after its CEO flagged slower growth, and that retail investors called the selloff "stupid." The article body could not be retrieved.
stories.whyItMatters: If the headline is accurate, it records a sharp share move on a growth warning from management; it is not a forecast.

sourceLinks.title: Duolingo Stock Heads For Worst Day In Months As CEO Flags Slower Growth — Retail Calls Selloff ‘Stupid’ - Stocktwits

stories.headline: Rocket Lab's backlog is $2.36 billion, more than double its 2026 revenue, per a Motley Fool headline
stories.summary: A Motley Fool headline puts Rocket Lab's backlog at $2.36 billion, more than twice its 2026 revenue, and says the stock still fell. The article body could not be retrieved.
stories.whyItMatters: If the headline is accurate, contracted work outweighs this year's sales even as the shares dropped.

sourceLinks.title: Rocket Lab's Backlog Is $2.36 Billion -- More Than Double Its 2026 Revenue -- and the Stock Still Fell 38% This Month. Here's the Disconnect. - The Motley Fool

stories.headline: Gold slips under $4,000 as speculators cut long exposure, FXLeaders says
stories.summary: An FXLeaders headline reports gold trading below $4,000 as speculators reduced long exposure, and frames the XAU/USD outlook as bearish. The article body could not be retrieved.
stories.whyItMatters: If the headline is accurate, positioning data is cited alongside the move under $4,000.

stories.headline: Tether Gold reaches $3.3 billion as demand for bullion-backed tokens climbs, CoinMarketCap reports
stories.summary: A CoinMarketCap headline says Tether Gold has reached $3.3 billion as demand for bullion-backed tokens climbs. The article body could not be retrieved.
stories.whyItMatters: If the headline is accurate, gold-backed tokens are drawing more capital at the same time spot gold is under $4,000.

sourceLinks.title: Tether Gold Hits $3.3B as Bullion-Backed Token Demand Climbs - CoinMarketCap

stories.headline: Alibaba's Qwen3-Max tops a live crypto trading test, as China pushes domestic AI chips, Briefs Finance says
stories.summary: A Briefs Finance headline says Alibaba's Qwen3-Max came out on top in a live crypto trading test, alongside news that China is pushing domestic AI chips. The article body could not be retrieved.

stories.headline: Bitwise raises its 10-year bitcoin price target to $1.6 million, per a Motley Fool headline
stories.summary: A Motley Fool headline says Bitwise has lifted its 10-year bitcoin price target to $1.6 million. The article body could not be retrieved.
stories.whyItMatters: If the headline is accurate, it records a revised forecast from Bitwise; a target is an opinion, not an outcome.
